BiblicalUsage: Millet, one of the grains Ezekiel was told to mix into his bread during the siege sign, a poor man's grain for a hard season.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God speaks through a loaf of mixed grain as plainly as through a sermon, and the siege bread preached judgment before a word was said.
